usedFor: Better Stack holds incidents, and Slack receives the update when “Incident Is Updated” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Incident Is Updated” in Better Stack, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Every incident change reaches your team channel, so nobody checks a dashboard to see status.

watchOut: A post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today, so “Send Message” reaches the channel after you approve.
